name: bridge-tally
description: Read the TallyPrime books on this computer, and prepare Journal, Payment, Receipt and Contra vouchers as a local file. Posting is off by default; when voucher posting is turned on in the settings below, it can post one Journal, Payment, Receipt or Contra at a time, and every posting needs your approval in a native dialog. What it reads, including amounts, goes to your AI provider; Response redaction below can only mask party names or drop narration.

host.title: Tally host
host.description: Loopback host of the local Tally instance (localhost, 127.0.0.1, or ::1).

port.title: Tally port
port.description: HTTP port of the local Tally instance.

redaction.title: Response redaction
redaction.description: Enter none, mask_parties, or drop_narration. Other values prevent the connector from starting.

enable_writes.title: Allow voucher posting (Journal, Payment, Receipt, Contra)
enable_writes.description: Off by default. Turning this on lets the connector post one approved Journal, Payment, Receipt or Contra into Tally at a time. Two known limits remain. Tally aims an import at a company by name and cannot bind it to a GUID: Bridge's last request before the post refuses unless exactly one loaded company has the target's GUID and name and no other has the same name ignoring case and spacing (bridge#607), but a company renamed to, or loaded under, that name in the moment after the check could still receive the voucher; Bridge may flag afterwards that the companies changed, but cannot always say where it went, and cannot prevent it (accepted residual, bridge#574). And Bridge has no tool to delete or undo a voucher it has posted, so a wrong post must be corrected by hand in Tally (bridge#579). A ledger renamed and replaced in that same moment can likewise receive the post; Bridge marks it as needing reconciliation when it sees the ledger now resolves to a different master (bridge#623). Leave it off unless you accept that risk. It also lets you record, in a separate native dialog, that you reviewed a posted voucher whose ledgers changed master; that writes nothing to Tally. Reads, bank-statement parsing and voucher file preparation are available either way.
